name: Cascaded Voxel Cone Tracing Debug Visualization
definition: A debug visualization technique for cascaded voxel cone tracing that renders ray-traced voxel data into a 2D image buffer. It supports four distinct debug modes (0-3) to visualize different voxel attributes: opacity, color, energy, and normals.
summary: Cascaded Voxel Cone Tracing Debug Visualization renders ray-traced voxel data into a 2D buffer to isolate and composite raw voxel attributes like opacity, color, energy, and normals for diagnostic inspection.
